title: Vendor return lookup offers an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RET Vendor) exists.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RET-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RET PART A) and vendor {Vendor-A}, is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RET-02), vendor {Vendor-A}, is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active; its number starts the same as {Part-A}'s.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Returns and start a new return (the "Create Return" page).
  2. Pick Vendor {Vendor-A}.
  3. Type the start that {Part-A} and {Part-B} share (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RET-0) in the Part Number lookup.
  4. Pick {Part-A}.
  5. Set Qty To Return to 1 and Price Per Unit to 10.00, and click "Save Return".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Both {Part-A} and {Part-B} are offered. {Part-A} carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description; {Part-B} has no tag.
  • Step 4: {Part-A} fills the line with {Description-A} and its stock, 4.
  • Step 5: The return saves with {Part-A} on it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R11, S9-R12, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.6 (Vendor return: still offered, tagged), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R11: “Part lookup on a vendor return and on a vendor credit includes inactive parts.”
  • S9-R12: “In those lookups an inactive part carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description.”
